title: Shesh Theke Shuru
desc: Mahid, a Dhaka-based businessman, falls in love with a girl on a flight to London. Soon enough, his relationship is threatened as his dark past resurfaces.

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Tarini Tarama
desc: Rajababu prohibits all religious devotion, causing villagers to oppose his oppressive deeds. Jasodha, his spouse, performs sacred worship secretly; ultimately, Rajababu converts to a staunch devotee.

title: Baba Keno Chakar
desc: When Rajnarayan asks his son to help out with the expenses for his sister's wedding, he refuses. As a result, he is forced to go from pillar to post to make ends meet.

title: Boumar Banabash
desc: A royal couple faces divine punishment as the wife endures exile while the prince grapples with a mysterious curse that threatens both love and destiny.

title: Putrabadhu
desc: The members of a joint family go through various ups and downs in their lives and attempt to stay together despite all the odds stacked against them.

title: Debibaran
desc: Satyapriyo fights for justice when his sister is raped. During his fight, he takes on a corrupt village official in a twisted turn of events.
